situation: An industry association where members can dump waste cheaply (defect) or treat it (cooperate) — a compliance body can fine polluters, but running it costs the honest members dues, so some cooperate without paying to enforce

players.name: Enforcer
players.note: Cooperates and pays into the compliance body that fines polluters

players.name: GoodCitizen
players.note: Cooperates but does not pay to enforce — a second-order free-rider

players.name: Polluter
players.note: Dumps waste when it can get away with it

rationale.R: everyone treats waste = clean industry, steady
rationale.T: dump once while others treat = cheap disposal windfall
rationale.P: everyone dumps = fouled commons, all bleed
rationale.S: treat while others dump = you pay costs, they don't
rationale.w: the industry persists for many cycles
rationale.noise: a treatment failure misread as deliberate dumping
rationale.punishment: beta = the fine a caught polluter pays; gamma = dues the enforcer pays to run the body; pool = dues are owed every period, even when nobody pollutes (the second-order free-rider trap)
